description: This file implements a transformation pass that rewrites matrices in row-major layout to column-major layout within an abstract syntax tree (AST) for shader code. It handles struct and interface block conversions, matrix transpositions, and expression transformations for reading and writing matrices and structs, including handling array and struct members. The code defines a class for traversing and modifying the AST to apply these transformations.

classes.name: RewriteRowMajorMatricesTraverser
classes.description: A class that traverses the AST to convert row-major matrices and structs to column-major layout, handling read/write transformations, struct/interface block conversions, and expression rewriting.

methods.name: RewriteRowMajorMatrices
methods.description: Main function that initiates the AST transformation to rewrite row-major matrices as column-major.
